reply_text:
I've saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki, and I've replied to Anselm in the DM to say so.

- **Draft:** it goes to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101 per-seat figure, says the rate is proposed and came from Marcus Lindqvist, and says Anselm approved sharing it. It also asks Hollis not to pass it on without approval from Anselm or June. It hasn't been sent; someone has to review it and send it.
- **Why no further approval was needed:** Hollis isn't one of the people who can see finance figures by default. As CFO, Anselm can approve that, and he did in this message. The address is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway's approval for outside mail doesn't apply.
- **Not checked:** I didn't find where Marcus first gave the figure. I used the $2,101 Anselm stated. GBrain had nothing on Thornbury Cloth Co., but its search was running in a reduced mode, so that doesn't prove there are no notes.
